response.text:
I can’t open or cite the annual report because no file or pages were provided and I don’t have web/PDF access right now. Please upload the report (PDF) or paste the relevant pages. 

When you provide the PDF I will:
- Inspect the document pages directly.
- Extract each emissions target (Scope 1/2/3, net-zero, interim targets, base year, target year).
- Provide page-level citations in the form: "Annual Report — page X: [exact quote or paraphrase]" so you can verify them.

If helpful, say whether you want only targets or also supporting text (methodology, emissions boundary, offsets).
